name: @weavetab/mcp
description: The open automation engine for AI agents. Control live browsers and desktop apps locally with instant execution.
author: fy2ne

browser_map.description: Snapshot interactive DOM with stable ref IDs (w:NN). For complex SPAs, use scope or query to constrain tokens. Supports delta temporal diffing (up to 97% token reduction), semantic pruning (dropping hidden elements), Set-of-Marks visual grounding (visual: true / "auto" for canvas/WebGL pages), AX tree fallback (Shadow DOM traversal), scope filtering, query filtering, and forced rebuilds with automatic loop strike reset (force: true).
features: Semantic DOM pruning (up to 97% token reduction with delta)
Shadow DOM / AX tree fallback parsing
Scope and query filtering for complex SPAs
Loop strike counter reset on forced re-mapping (force: true)

browser_navigate.description: Navigate to a URL. Enforces domain security policies and rate limits prior to navigation. Waits for network idle and DOM readiness. Supports internal protocol schemes (e.g. weavetab://).
features: Domain policy engine and blocklist enforcement
Deterministic DOM stability and network idle waiting

browser_click.description: Click a DOM element. Physical click engine incorporating Bézier curve trajectory kinematics (Ghost Cursor). Multi-stage targeting fallback: mark number (SoM visual grounding) -> ref ID -> selector -> label -> intent -> coordinates -> backendNodeId.
features: Direct mark number targeting (mark: N) from visual mode

browser_type.description: Type text into a single input field. Keystroke dispatch engine with per-character temporal jitter and burst profiling. Real-time DOM-diffing monitors stuck input state. Supports atomic clearFirst and clipboard paste modes.
features: Stuck-typing loop detection via DOM diffing
Clipboard paste injection for long text

browser_type_secret.description: Inject a secret from an environment variable / secrets.json. Blind Injection: securely injects credentials without exposing sensitive values to the LLM context. Permanently masked as [REDACTED] in DOM maps and logs.
features: Zero LLM context exposure for credentials
Permanent [REDACTED] masking across logs and snapshots

browser_key.description: Press a keyboard key. Dispatches native hardware key events with modifier key support (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Meta) to focused elements.
features: Native key code and key identifier mapping

browser_scroll.description: Scroll the page or targeted element. Smooth scrolling engine via CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent wheel events. Supports directional delta scrolling and element-relative scroll centering.
features: Element-relative scroll targeting via ref ID or label

browser_dialog.description: Accept or dismiss JS dialogs (alert, confirm, prompt) via CDP Page.handleJavaScriptDialog.
features: Handling of alert, confirm, and prompt modal types

browser_burst.description: HIGH-SPEED MULTI-ACTION PIPELINE: Executes 2 or more sequential browser actions in a single round-trip without waiting for LLM turns between steps. PREFER THIS over individual single-action calls to slash latency and token burn. Supports native primitives (browser_click, browser_fill, browser_type, browser_type_secret, browser_navigate, browser_key, browser_scroll, browser_wait, browser_map) plus compound macros (type_and_send, click_and_wait, navigate_and_read, scroll_and_read, fill_form). If compile_from_history: true is passed, automatically compiles and executes recent successful session trail actions into a burst macro.
features: Single-request multi-action pipeline execution with zero intermediate LLM round-trips
Compound macro abstractions (type_and_send, click_and_wait, navigate_and_read, scroll_and_read, fill_form, drag_and_drop, hover_and_read)
Automatic session history compilation into replayable burst macros (compile_from_history: true)
Fail-fast execution guard (stop_on_error: true) to prevent cascading errors
Automatic loop counter reset on execution start

browser_tabs.description: Manage browser and Electron app tabs/windows (open, switch, close, list). Specify 'app' when targeting desktop apps (e.g. app: 'discord') to avoid opening web browser.

browser_wait.description: Pause until a condition is met ('element', 'text', 'url', 'stable', 'network', 'auto'). Deterministic wait engine for asynchronous web state synchronization.
features: Element, text, URL, DOM stability, and network idle conditions

browser_captcha.description: Autonomous zero-API detection and solving of Turnstile, reCAPTCHA, GeeTest, and hCaptcha bot challenges using local CDP behavioral solvers.
features: Cloudflare Turnstile, reCAPTCHA v2/v3, GeeTest, and hCaptcha support

browser_thoughts.description: Agent-to-user communication layer rendered in the middle down of the page. Supports question mode (interactive prompt with answer submission) and feedback mode (status, observation, decision, or warning update). Supports contextual element anchoring (anchor: 'w:NN') and visual styles ('observation', 'decision', 'warning', 'question').
features: Middle-down floating card HUD with precision dark styling
Question mode (interactive user response directly on page)

browser_pointer.description: Advanced pointer control (hover, click, double_click, drag_and_drop) with Bézier curve kinematics. Supports waitForChild pattern for dynamic flyout menus.
features: Hover, click, double_click, and drag_and_drop actions

browser_select.description: Select an option from a native dropdown by visible text or value. Uses native property setters and dispatches input/change events for framework compatibility (React, Vue, Angular).
features: Option matching by visible text or value
Synthetic input and change event dispatch

browser_fill.description: Smart multi-field form-filling. Evaluates field control types (text, select, checkbox, radio, contenteditable) and processes inputs sequentially with atomic verification.

browser_highlight.description: Highlight elements on page. Renders temporary visual overlays over target elements without DOM tree mutations. Supports multi-element consideration overlays (refs: ['w:12', 'w:15']), presentation styles ('consideration', 'target', 'danger', 'success', 'shimmer'), floating badges, and configurable durations.
features: Five visual styles: consideration, target lock, danger, success, shimmer
Floating label badge display above highlighted elements
Targeting via ref IDs (w:NN), CSS selectors, or CDP backendNodeId

browser_upload.description: Upload files to a file input. Bypasses OS native file pickers via CDP DOM.setFileInputFiles directly targeting file input node IDs using absolute file paths.
features: Zero OS file picker interaction required

browser_find.description: Sub-5ms CDP text search. Zero token waste. Best for locating specific keywords/text on page without a full DOM walk.
features: Native CDP search (zero DOM walk overhead)
Exact keyword matching and match indexing

browser_storage.description: Manage localStorage and sessionStorage. Reads, writes, and clears key-value pairs for the active origin.

browser_checkpoint.description: Snapshot and restore browser state (cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, and scroll/URL) into named checkpoints to time-travel and rollback failed automation branches.
features: Cookies backup and restoration (HttpOnly and Secure via CDP)
URL, page title, and viewport scroll position persistence

browser_network_intercept.description: Intercept/stub network responses (mock APIs, block tracking) and capture raw protocol network telemetry (TLS/SSL certificate metadata, microsecond timing breakdown, and OS-level network failure reasons).
features: URL glob pattern matching and response mocking
TLS/SSL Certificate security metadata (issuer, protocol, validity, cipher)
Microsecond Network Timing breakdown (DNS, TCP, SSL, send, TTFB, download)
OS-level network failure diagnostics (net::ERR_* codes, blocked reasons)

browser_console.description: 1-5ms latency access to buffered browser console messages, JS exceptions, and network errors tracked via CDP Runtime.consoleAPICalled.

browser_pdf.description: Print the current page to a PDF file via CDP Page.printToPDF with configurable orientation, scale, and page ranges.

browser_eval.description: Run arbitrary JS via CDP in page context via CDP Runtime.evaluate. Supports asynchronous evaluation and structured JSON serialization.

browser_cookies.description: Manage browser cookies. Full CRUD management for HTTP and document cookies via CDP Network domain.
features: Cookie property retrieval, setting, and deletion

browser_canvas.description: For ALL canvas content (charts, games, graphs). Use get_image to read pixel data as Base64 PNG, draw to simulate programmatic coordinate gesture paths.
features: Canvas node targeting via ref ID or selector

browser_scrape.description: Sub-5ms latency, zero waste extraction via CSS or XPath selectors in a single CDP evaluation step. Returns structured text/attribute arrays.

browser_snapshot.description: Capture or restore an MHTML snapshot (DOM + inline assets). Facilitates offline state serialization, replay verification, and compliance auditing.
features: Full DOM and asset stream serialization

browser_screenshot.description: 95-135ms capture latency via CDP Page.captureScreenshot. Supports PNG and JPEG formats, full-page rendering, and clip region bounding boxes.
features: Full-page and viewport bounding box capture
Custom clip region bounding box support
In-memory Base64 data URL output (zero disk I/O)

browser_viewport.description: Set viewport dimensions and device emulation (width, height, DPR, mobile, geolocation, timezone, locale, color scheme).
features: Viewport width, height, and DPR emulation
Mobile viewport and touch event emulation

browser_clipboard.description: Read or write to the system clipboard (plaintext or Base64 image payload data).
features: Plaintext and Base64 image payload format support

browser_inspect.description: 15-35ms latency, zero waste. Deep DOM inspection returning computed styles, inline styles, box model dimensions, and attached event listener types.
features: Targeting via ref ID, selector, or nodeId

browser_extract_design.description: Extract design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, shadows, CSS variables), semantic HTML layouts, and clean CSS into structured files and an LLM design blueprint. Ideal for cloning websites, UI components, and design systems with 100% pixel fidelity.
features: CSS custom properties and design token harvesting
Palette extraction and typography hierarchy mapping
Semantic clean DOM extraction with inline SVGs preserved
Automatic file persistence into configurable designDir (~/.weavetab/designs/)
Compact LLM summary preventing context window bloat

browser_automation.description: Inject self-running background script for monitoring/polling. Inject persistent scripts into the page context for continuous event tracking.

browser_recording.description: Record video screencasts of browser sessions. Automatically compiles captured frames into animated video files (.webp, .gif, .webm, .mp4) using native Node processing or system ffmpeg.
features: Native WebP/GIF animation compilation in pure Node

browser_detect.description: CRITICAL INITIALIZATION TOOL. Detect available browsers and configured desktop apps (Discord, Slack, etc.). Call this FIRST before interacting with the environment to know if apps are online/offline and what tabs they have open.
features: Tool compatibility reporting per browser engine

browser_performance.description: Retrieve page performance metrics. Collects Core Web Vitals (FCP, LCP, CLS) and detailed network resource timing distributions.
features: First Contentful Paint (FCP) and Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) capture

browser_pattern_learn.description: Read (action=get), register (action=learn), update, or record execution outcome for a named workflow pattern on a given origin in ~/.weavetab-system/memory/sites/. Use action=get at session start to inspect site profiles and reliability scores. Use learn after completing a flow to persist it for future fast-path replay.
features: Named pattern creation and update (merge-on-write, no duplicates)
EWMA reliability score update on execution outcome

browser_office.description: Read and extract structured content from office documents (Excel, Word, PDF, CSV) via live browser session cookies or local downloads directory.

browser_emulate.description: Emulate browser environmental conditions over CDP: network throttling profiles, CPU slowdown multipliers, geolocation overrides, timezone IDs, and custom User-Agent strings.

session_memory.description: Two-tier persistent memory system. Tier 1 (~/.weavetab-system/memory/): per-domain selector confidence cache tracking detected web frameworks, Shadow DOM utilization, and interaction strategies. Tier 2 (~/.weavetab-system/memory/sites/): named workflow patterns with EWMA reliability scores, site quirks (cookie banners, rate limits), and fast-path eligibility flags — all accumulated and refined across sessions.
features: Framework detection (React, Vue, Angular, Lit, Svelte, Next, Nuxt, Gatsby)
Successful selector strategy caching with confidence decay (Tier 1)
Named workflow pattern compilation with EWMA reliability scoring (Tier 2)
Site quirk registration: cookie banners, rate limits, modal popups (Tier 2)
Fast-path eligibility: patterns with reliability ≥ 0.8 skip exploratory DOM navigation

knowledge_hints.description: Domain-specific hint storage (~/.weavetab/knowledge/[domain].md) injecting context notes into session prompts.

trail_log.description: Rolling 50-action window (~/.weavetab-system/sessions/context.json) powering strike-based loop detection algorithms.
features: Auto-reset triggers on navigation, tab switch, or burst start

network_telemetry.description: Real-time network event tracking via CDP Network domain measuring request/response timing and HTTP error rates.

mutation_observer.description: CDP-driven DOM mutation tracking measuring dynamic subtree changes for SPA stabilization.

semantic_delta_engine.description: Per-tab DOM state diffing engine returning strictly modified elements between snapshots, cutting prompt token consumption up to 97%.
features: Property-level change detection (label, value, state, class)

semantic_dom_pruner.description: AST-based DOM compression algorithm executed before snapshot returns. Removes non-interactive hidden elements and converts SVG icons to tokens.

vision_fallback.description: Local pixel analysis pipeline using sharp for visual layout evaluation when accessibility trees return zero nodes.
vision_fallback.pipeline: AX Tree Check -> Screenshot -> Grayscale -> 4x4 Grid Heatmap -> Text Density -> Clickable Region Analysis

loop_detection.description: Strike-based loop detection algorithm over rolling 50-action windows with automated escalation.

thresholds.10+ strikes: Stuck state classification and auto-recovery activation

features: Manual reset via browser_map({ force: true }) or browser_wait({ reset_loop: true })

framework_detection.description: Heuristic detection of web application frameworks via CDP Runtime.evaluate probes.

intent_resolution.description: Semantic element resolution resolving natural language action descriptions to DOM ref IDs using session memory scoring.

rbac.description: Role-Based Access Control enforcing tool execution boundaries based on configured session role.

roles.admin: Full access to all tools and system operations
roles.operator: Full access to all tools and system operations (same as admin)
roles.system: System-level tools only (browser_thoughts, browser_detect, browser_performance, browser_checkpoint, browser_pattern_learn)
roles.viewer: Read-only access (browser_map, browser_find, browser_scrape, browser_console, browser_eval, browser_inspect, browser_extract_design, browser_snapshot, browser_screenshot, browser_pdf, browser_cookies, browser_tabs, browser_wait, browser_pattern_learn)
roles.automation: Full tool access excluding browser_thoughts (automation agents must be non-interactive)

domain_policy.description: Domain-level access control policy engine configured via the top-level policies array in ~/.weavetab/config.json with enforced security domain blocklists.

modes.audit: Unrestricted access with enhanced audit logging

rate_limiting.description: Mutex-guarded rate limiter enforcing maximum action frequencies.

blind_injection.description: Credential injection via browser_type_secret. Resolves secret values server-side from secrets.json without context exposure to the LLM.

input_filter.description: Sanitizes DOM snapshots before context return by stripping prompt injection patterns and invisible characters.

additional_mechanisms.localhost_binding: CDP WebSocket connection restricted strictly to 127.0.0.1
additional_mechanisms.root_guard: Startup execution block for root/superuser processes (Unix)
additional_mechanisms.storage_blocker: Configurable nullification of web storage and document.cookie
additional_mechanisms.atomic_config_writes: Atomic configuration file writes via temporary file renaming
additional_mechanisms.path_traversal_protection: Strict validation of download and profile directories against path traversal
additional_mechanisms.two_factor_lock_validation: Browser lock verification via PID liveness and TCP port checks

stdio.description: Standard JSON-RPC over stdio streams. Default mode for MCP clients.

websocket.description: JSON-RPC over WebSocket for distributed agent pipelines.

hud.description: Shadow DOM HUD overlay injected into browser tabs displaying execution state and thoughts.

ghost_cursor.description: Visual pointer trajectory overlay displaying humanized Bézier motion during interaction.

plugins.description: Dynamic plugin system discovering any npm package containing weavetab.json and @weavetab/plugin-* packages at startup.

skills.description: Optional companion package (@weavetab/skills) providing mission templates.

devMode.description: Verbose CDP logging and HUD overlay toggle

actionabilityTimeoutMs.description: Element actionability wait timeout in ms

metadata.token_efficiency: Up to 97% reduction via semantic delta engine + DOM pruner
metadata.architecture: Direct CDP WebSocket (Layer 0) — zero WebDriver, Playwright, or Puppeteer wrapper overhead
metadata.security: Domain blacklist + RBAC (5 roles) + rate limiting + Blind Injection (secrets.json)
metadata.session_memory: Persistent per-domain profiles with framework detection and strategy caching
